meta.note: Graded curriculum for Taiwanese Mandarin, HSK 2 → 4 with HSK 1 review woven in. Traditional characters, Taiwan usage. Units are ordered by increasing difficulty and each vocab item is tagged with its own approximate HSK level, so progression and the 'words by level' dashboard read honestly. Taiwan daily-life themes per spec §4.2. Hand-authored and vocab-validated (every sentence uses only characters met by that point + the HSK 1 pool + the function-word allowlist). Expandable via backend/scripts/generate_content.py.

grammar.title: 了 — a completed action

grammar.title: Time before the verb
grammar.explanation: In Chinese the time when something happens comes before the verb, not after: 我晚上回家 = I go home in the evening. Time can also lead the whole sentence.

grammar.title: 用 — the means / instrument
grammar.explanation: 用 ("to use") marks the tool or method you do something with. Put 用 + the means before the verb: 用現金付 = pay with cash.

grammar.title: 只 — only
grammar.explanation: 只 ("only") goes right before the verb to limit it: 只收現金 = only accept cash.

grammar.title: 還是 — "or" in questions
grammar.explanation: 還是 offers a choice between two options in a question: A 還是 B = "A or B?". Don't use 或 (huò) here — 或 is for statements, 還是 is for questions.
